prompt: A server restarts with both RDB and AOF enabled and both files present. Which dataset does Redis load?
explanation: When AOF is enabled, Redis rebuilds the dataset from the AOF, because it is the more complete record of acknowledged writes; the RDB file is still useful for fast restarts and backups, but the AOF wins at load time.

options.text: The AOF, because it is the more complete record of acknowledged writes
The RDB, because the snapshot format loads faster
Whichever file was written most recently
Redis merges both files, applying the RDB snapshot then replaying the AOF on top
